description.value: Ramada by Wyndham Coquitlam is a mid-scale chain hotel on Lougheed Highway, a major arterial road in the Tri-Cities area of Metro Vancouver. As part of the Wyndham portfolio, it offers standard hotel services in a suburban location with road access to regional cycling routes and amenities. Touring cyclists passing through the Metro Vancouver–Coquitlam corridor may find it a practical overnight stop.
